flags.name: AGENTIC_SPACE_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS18-S5: a Do run in a project forwards its Space retrieval decision to execution-core so knowledge_search is Space-scoped. Off, org-wide. Deploy execution-core (reads x-space-retrieval-authorization) first. Only the literal true.

flags.name: AGENTIC_SUBSCRIPTION_ALLOW_EFFECTS
flags.purpose: Second Do-mode switch. Lets subscription runs take effects. It grants nothing while AGENTIC_SUBSCRIPTION_ENABLED is off. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AGENTIC_SUBSCRIPTION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Do-mode master switch for ChatGPT-subscription runs, the agentic loop. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AGENT_API_BUDGET_CHECK
flags.purpose: O-18 / F-f10-23b: Agent API key turns are checked against the org's spend ceilings (cost-core budget check for apikey:<key_id>) before the model call. Off, a key turn is not budget-checked. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AGENT_ASK_USER_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS14-S4: offer ask_user to a Do run (max_questions on the run request). Off by default: only the literal true turns it on. ZDR, waived, scheduled and Space-scoped runs never get it.

flags.name: AGENT_ASK_USER_RESUME_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS14-S5: accept the question form of /continue and relay awaiting_input. Only the literal true turns it on. Flip it with execution-core and session-core.

flags.name: AGENT_DEFINITION_VERSIONS
flags.purpose: EP-6 S7/S8: the agent builder routes (draft, publish, versions) and the draft preview of a chat body. Off, the builder routes answer 404 and a chat body's agent_preview is left as it came. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AGENT_MODES
flags.purpose: WS25-S6: the optional agent_mode on invoke (lockdown, read_only, ask_first, auto), strictest-wins over the platform floor and the org cap. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: ALLOWED_MODELS
flags.purpose: Comma-separated model allowlist for the gateway. Unset or empty allows every model.

flags.name: ALLOW_DEV_ACTOR_HEADERS
flags.purpose: Dev actor headers for the BFF. Only the literal true turns it on. Refused, with a log line, when APP_ENV is production or prod.

flags.name: ALLOW_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS
flags.purpose: Dev auth bypass for the BFF. Only the literal true turns it on; 1 and 0 read as off. Refused, with a log line, when APP_ENV is production or prod.

flags.name: ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV_DEFAULTS
flags.purpose: Lets a release build boot with placeholder dev keys. Dev only; APP_ENV does not refuse it. Only the literal 1 opens the gate; true, yes and on stay closed. Model Plane compose sends it blank. Also read by autocomplete-core, imports-core.

flags.name: ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_LEGACY_EVENTS
flags.purpose: Legacy unsigned doc-ready events for the model-gateway consumer. Opens only when ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV_DEFAULTS and ISOLATED_E2E are also the literal 1. Only the literal 1 turns it on.

flags.name: API_KEY_AGENT_EXCHANGE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: API-key exchange route for browser:agent grants (auth-core api-key-exchange.controller.ts). Needs API_KEY_ENABLED too. Only the literal true turns it on; off, the route answers 404.

flags.name: API_KEY_AGENT_RUNS
flags.purpose: INNH-10 GW-1: the x-api-key ingress for browser agent runs (/api/v1/api-key/agent/runs). Off, the routes are not mounted. Only 1 or the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: APPROVAL_AUDIT_EVENTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS13-S3: the approval decision audit event, a content-free approval_decided outbox row and its provenance record. Off by default; only the literal true.

flags.name: APPROVAL_EDIT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-10 S4: the owner's edit of a pending approval before it is decided. Off, an edit is refused with 403 approval_edit_disabled. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: APPROVAL_RULE_PROPOSALS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS13-S7 'Always' rule proposals and their list, confirm and dismiss routes. Needs APPROVAL_SCOPE_GRANTS_ENABLED, and TOOL_POLICY_ENFORCED plus TOOL_POLICY_RULE_AUDIT_ENABLED on capability-core. Only the literal true.

flags.name: APPROVAL_SCOPE_GRANTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS13-S6 standing grants. Only the literal true turns it on. Refused at boot if on with APPROVAL_AUDIT_EVENTS_ENABLED off. Off until execution-core holds approval:grant_use (D-WS13-5) and grants are digest-bound (W2-WS13-S7-grant-digest).

flags.name: APPROVAL_SHELL_RULE_PROPOSALS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-9 E4: shell-rule narrowing of WS13-S7 rule proposals. Stays off (D-WS13-6). Refused at startup unless APPROVAL_RULE_PROPOSALS_ENABLED is on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: APPROVAL_STEP_UP_ENFORCED
flags.purpose: WS13-S5 / F-f03-14: off changes nothing; shadow counts a grant that lacks a fresh re-authentication for its cause and lets it through; enforce refuses it with step_up_required. Unknown values are off.

flags.name: APPROVAL_WAIVER_REFUSE
flags.purpose: D2-1149: an approval create or decide from a waived run's credential is refused before any approval metadata is stored (DEC-32: waived counts as ZDR for new stores). Off keeps today's behaviour. Only the literal true.

flags.name: APPROVAL_WRITE_PREVIEW_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-10-S1: the owner-only decrypted preview of a pending write approval, never stored. Off, the route answers 404 preview_unavailable. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: ASSISTANT_NAVIGATION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Kill switch for the assistant navigation model call. Off, the route answers 503 assistant_navigation_unavailable and no model call is made. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AUDIT_ALLOW_NATS_TOKEN_FALLBACK
flags.purpose: Security-relaxing migration switch: audit-core and its extra NATS buses may connect with the shared NATS token instead of a scoped NATS user and password. Off requires the scoped credential. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AUDIT_CHAIN_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Audit hash chain on audit-core ingest (cmd/server). In production it needs the chain signing keys. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_DRYRUN
flags.purpose: Dry run of the chained audit purge (audit-core): it verifies and logs the plan, deletes no chained row, and wins over AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_ENABLED. A misread value refuses boot. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Pruning of audit rows, each batch signed by a chain checkpoint (audit-core cmd/server). AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_DRYRUN=true wins and never deletes. Needs the chain signing keys when on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AUDIT_CHAIN_VERIFY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Chain verifier on audit-core (cmd/server, verifier.Enabled). Blank, or the literal true, follows AUDIT_CHAIN_ENABLED; false, and any other value, turns verification off. It is always off with the chain off. Read-only.

flags.name: AUDIT_SIEM_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DESTINATIONS
flags.purpose: Dev-only lift of the SIEM address check for private destinations (audit-core cmd/siem-exporter). Only the literal true turns it on; with ENVIRONMENT=production the exporter refuses to start.

flags.name: AUDIT_SIEM_EXPORT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: SIEM export of the audit chain (audit-core cmd/siem-exporter). Off, the process serves metrics and exports nothing. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AUTH_CORE_ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-03b: Auth Core reads the effective ZDR posture that org-core computes (effectiveZdr) instead of keeping its own plan-lapse rule. Off keeps the stored-intent rule. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_ROUTE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-f03-15: the gateway's relay of Auth Core's password re-check behind a high-risk Model Plane approval (POST /api/v1/auth/step-up). Off, the route is not registered and answers 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AZURE_ANTHROPIC_ZDR_CONFIRMED
flags.purpose: Legacy ZDR boolean for the Azure Anthropic surface. An unattested true fails boot, because ZDR now needs the attestation fields. Leave false.

flags.name: AZURE_OPENAI_ZDR_CONFIRMED
flags.purpose: Legacy ZDR boolean for the Azure OpenAI surface. An unattested true fails boot, because ZDR now needs the attestation fields. Leave false.

flags.name: BROWSER_BROKER_ASSISTANT_TASK_GRANTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Lets a signed-in user's assistant task take its one-host cloud browser grant. Off, the broker refuses it with PermissionDenied. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_BROKER_FILL_OTP_ENABLED
flags.purpose: fill_otp sensitive approvals (E3.1, ADR-2a) in the browser broker: a one-time OTP fill bound to one https origin and one mail connection. Off until the OTP live proof; remove the switch after it. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_BROKER_HUMAN_BROWSE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Issues human_browse grants: open web minus the deny-list, renewable up to an absolute TTL. Only the literal true turns it on; 0 or false is off, and any other value stops the broker at boot.
flags.onDefaultReason: On in this development compose; docker-compose.production.yml sets it to 0.
flags.driftReason: Compose turns it on for development. Unset, the broker reads it as off.

flags.name: BROWSER_BROKER_KEY_GRANTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Lets an api_key principal acquire a browser key grant. Off, every api_key call is PermissionDenied and an existing key grant validates as revoked. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_BROKER_ORIGIN_EXTENSION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Lets a signed-in user take an origin_extension grant for a run. Off, every request is PermissionDenied and an existing extension validates as revoked. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_BROKER_WEB_POLICY_SNAPSHOT
flags.purpose: Reads the verified token's web_policy claim at acquire and narrows an ordinary grant's hosts; an unreadable claim refuses the mint. Only the literal true turns it on; 0 or false is off, anything else stops the broker.

flags.name: BROWSER_DO_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS21-S2: mints a browser bearer for a personal, non-ZDR agentic turn. Either this or BROWSER_SITES_ENABLED turns on the browser-site settings routes. Off, neither happens. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_HUMAN_BROWSE
flags.purpose: WS8.D: whether a session asks for a person's open-web human_browse grant. Only the literal true turns it on, in every environment.

flags.name: BROWSER_LIVE_VIEW_ONLY
flags.purpose: W3-E3.4-5: serves the owner view-only live route for a browser session. Off, that route answers 404. Quarry honours the scope only with QUARRY_EDGE__LIVE_VIEW_ONLY on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_POLICY_ADMIN_API
flags.purpose: WS7.H: the organisation browser policy admin routes. Off, or unset, answers 404 browser_policy_admin_disabled. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_RECIPES
flags.purpose: Q4-E4.2-4a: a browser session's receipts compile canonically and can be saved as a recipe, and saved recipes are listed. Only the literal true turns it on; off, the routes are absent.

flags.name: BROWSER_REGION_ATTACH
flags.purpose: E3.3-d: the browser region and selection attach route. The gateway re-resolves the tab and region against Quarry before it attaches the crop as browser-scraped evidence. Off, the route is not mounted. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_SITES_ENABLED
flags.purpose: The browser-site settings routes for the assistant (/api/v1/orgs/{id}/browser-sites). Either this or BROWSER_DO_ENABLED turns them on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_SPACE_FLOOR_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Space floor for the agent browser in the org-core browser-sites resolve (P2-cp-01): on, a Space that is not entitled, or whose floor is unreadable, is refused every host. Off, space_id is ignored. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_TAB_MENTIONS
flags.purpose: E3.3-c: re-resolves @tab mentions in a chat turn against Quarry live tab list before a model sees them. Off, the route is not mounted. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BUILTIN_OFFICE_SKILLS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS19-S9: first-party Office skills, docx, xlsx, pptx and pdf, listed for every org. Off by default: only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CAPABILITY_CORE_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_DECISIONS
flags.purpose: Security-relaxing dev-run opt-in: capability-core starts without a decision evidence signer, and execution-core denies allows it verifies. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CAPABILITY_CORE_ATTENTION_NOTIFY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS16-S4: RUN_ATTENTION notices, sent once session-core confirms the item waits. Needs SESSION_CORE_ATTENTION_ENABLED, SESSION_CORE_ATTENTION_EVENTS_ENABLED and NOTIFICATION_NATIVE_TYPES_ENABLED first. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CAPABILITY_CORE_SCHEDULED_NOTIFY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS20-S7: the scheduled-run outcome notice. Needs SESSION_CORE_SCHEDULED_OUTCOME_EVENTS_ENABLED (F-f05-05), the schedule-owner check (F-f05-06) and NOTIFICATION_NATIVE_TYPES_ENABLED first. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CAPABILITY_ORG_WEB_MODE_COVERS_BROWSER
flags.purpose: F-f09-13 / O-19: the org's web.covers_browser decides whether browser tools (cap.browser.open, observe, act) follow web.mode. Off, the key is neither shown nor accepted. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CAPABILITY_ORG_WEB_MODE_GATE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-f09-13: the org's web.mode withholds the public-web capabilities (cap.tool.http, cap.web.crawl, cap.web.map, cap.web.batch) for every caller. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CAPABILITY_PERMISSION_RULES_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-t3-074 org permission rules: execution-core names a call's target and capability-core applies the org's deny and ask rules to it. Only the literal true turns it on; off, no target is sent and no rule is read.

flags.name: CHAT_ARTIFACT_PROMOTE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-3 S8: saves a document artifact version to knowledge from the Output panel. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CHAT_ATTACHMENT_HOSTED_IMAGE_HOSTS
flags.purpose: F-f01-12: comma-separated lower-case hosts a hosted image URL may name (*. and a domain for any subdomain). Set, the URL must be https, with no userinfo, no IP literal and a listed host, else attachment_encoding_invalid. Empty: any.

flags.name: CHAT_DO_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS08-S6: a Do run carries the turn's attachments, declared as modes.do_attachments. Opt-in, unset is off: only the literal true enables it. Flip it with VITE_CHAT_DO_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED.

flags.name: CHAT_LOCALE_HINT
flags.purpose: WS16-S6: stamps the viewer interface language (nb-NO or en-US) on the model-bound body as the locale field. Off removes the field. A framing hint only, never stored. Any value other than 1, true, yes or on turns it off.
flags.onDefaultReason: Dev default on through space_flag: an unset value is on outside production. The production overlay sets it false.

flags.name: CHAT_MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W5, F-t3-090: POST /api/v1/chat/transcripts, which transcribes one audio upload and saves the text as a private media_transcript document. Off, the route answers 404 media_transcripts_disabled. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CHAT_PROCESS_OUTPUT_READ_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-P3: the owner's read of one background process's output, GET /api/v1/chat/runs/{run_id}/processes/{pid}/output. Off, the route answers 404 process_output_disabled. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CHAT_RESEARCH_RUNS
flags.purpose: Quarry v2 E4.6: the person's read and stop of one research run, under /api/v1/chat/research-runs. Only the literal true turns it on; off, the routes are not registered.

flags.name: CHAT_SANDBOX_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS08-S5: opt-in sandbox staging of attached files, declared so the policy publishes what the server can do with a file. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CHAT_SNAPSHOTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-SH-6: the owner's governed snapshot links and the member's read of a shared snapshot. Off, every snapshot route answers 404 chat_snapshots_disabled. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CHAT_VISION_AS_PARTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS08-S4: images ride to the model as parts instead of the vision diversion. Opt-in, unset is off: only the literal true enables it. Flip it with VITE_CHAT_VISION_AS_PARTS_ENABLED.

flags.name: CLIENT_ENV_IDENTITY
flags.purpose: F-t3-098: GET /api/v1/client-config reports the closed environment label (production, staging, development or other) derived from APP_ENV. Off, the key is left out. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CLIENT_MIN_CONTRACT
flags.purpose: The oldest client contract the gateway still serves (WS07-S3). A higher value moves stale tabs onto the banner. It never goes below the compiled-in floor, and an unparsable value is ignored.

flags.name: CLIENT_VERSION_POLICY
flags.purpose: WS07-S3: what a stale client does. off shows nothing, banner shows a non-blocking notice, and enforce may reload a tab that holds no unsaved work. Unknown values are banner.

flags.name: CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Codex broker for the user's own ChatGPT subscription. Off, the broker is not built. Read as a Go bool: 1, t or true turn it on; on and yes do not. Needs CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_HOME and CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_MODEL_PLANE_API_KEY.

flags.name: CODE_INTERPRETER_VERIFY_ENFORCE
flags.purpose: WS19-S3: holds back a file whose structural check failed, once per turn, so the model can repair it. Off until a corpus run shows under 2 percent false failures. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONNECTOR_ASK_READS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS23-S5: Ask-mode connector reads for the connections the person selected, with citations and no body text in history. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONNECTOR_SCOPE_RECORD_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS23-S4: a Do run records the ids of the connected accounts selected for the turn on its run record (run_context.connector_scope), ids only; never for a ZDR or waived run. Off, nothing is recorded. Only the literal true; read at start.

flags.name: CONNECTOR_SUGGESTIONS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-10 S8: the suggest_connector tool and its connector suggestion card in Ask. Off by default: only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTENT_SAFETY_NORMALIZE
flags.purpose: Normalised injection scan: tighten-only, adds a NOTE and an audit event. Only a falsey word (0, false, no or off) opts out and restores the sixteen-phrase path. session-core's write gate ignores it.
flags.onDefaultReason: On by default. The normalised scan only adds flags, so it can make a screen more cautious and never less. The code default is on too, so this declaration changes nothing at runtime.

flags.name: CONTENT_SAFETY_SEMANTIC_INLINE
flags.purpose: WS26-S6: the inline, tighten-only prompt-injection pass over external tool results. Only the literal true turns it on. Keep it off until the owner has seen the live proof.

flags.name: CONTENT_WRITE_POLICY
flags.purpose: WS26-S4: one content policy on every memory write. Unset, blank or off (surrounding space removed) runs no check; exactly report counts refusals and lets writes through; exactly enforce refuses them. Any other set value runs as report.

flags.name: CONTROL_ALLOW_INSECURE_SESSION_RUN_AUTHORITY_LOOPBACK
flags.purpose: Security-relaxing development opt-in: plaintext to session-core's run authority, only at an IP-loopback address. Off keeps TLS. Other spellings of true are refused. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTROL_OWNER_ASSERTED_GRANTS
flags.purpose: WS14-S2: owner-asserted grant writes on user-core's authz grant surface, admitted only for the registered owner service of a resource type. Off, the surface answers 403 and stays fenced. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTROL_PLANE_ENFORCEMENT
flags.purpose: Control-plane enforcement mode for the BFF. Unknown values fall back to off. The gateway compose sets strict when the variable is unset; the code reads off when the variable is absent.

flags.name: CONTROL_SPACE_MEMORY_DECISIONS
flags.purpose: EP-8 S7: user-core signs model.space.memory.manage decisions for a shared Space's manager or owner; off answers 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTROL_SPACE_SHARED_IMPORT
flags.purpose: WS14-S1: shared-Space import decisions for room uploads. Off, a shared import answers 404 shared_import_disabled and the personal-only path stays. A rollout control, never an authorization input. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTROL_SPACE_SUBJECT_GRANTS
flags.purpose: WS14-S2: Space-subject grants on user-core. Off, file-grant and GET /authz/space-visible answer 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONVERSATION_ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-03d: conversation-core's org-core reader uses the effective posture (retention_posture.effective_zdr) instead of the raw interactiveRetention.zdr flag. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: COST_CORE_ACCEPT_API_KEY
flags.purpose: O-18: cost-core admits an api_key principal on POST /api/v1/budget/check only, for its own key (user_id apikey:<key_id>). model-gateway reads the same literal for the key's own cost-core bearer. Off, refused. Only the literal true.

flags.name: COST_CORE_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL
flags.purpose: Local-test opt-in for an in-memory cost ledger when DATABASE_URL is unset. Off, a missing DATABASE_URL is a startup error. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: COST_CORE_IMAGE_PRICING_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Prices image_generation usage per image from image_price_rates. No row is seeded, so an unpriced image is recorded with no image cost and flagged. Off, image events record as ordinary usage. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CRAWL_APPROVAL_MODE
flags.purpose: The knowledge crawl approval gate: off, observe or enforce. Unset or unrecognised means observe. Read once per process, with CRAWL_APPROVAL_PAGES as its threshold.

flags.name: CREDENTIAL_BINDINGS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Credential-binding admin routes in integration-corev2: an org admin binds a secret to one host, sealed here and never returned. Off, the routes answer 404. Needs the credential encryption key. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CREDENTIAL_BINDINGS_UI_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-CC-8: the org credential-binding routes and the custom REST connector route. Off, each answers 404 credential_bindings_disabled and nothing is sent to Integration Core. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CRON_SWEEPER_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Background cron sweeper in capability-core. Only the exact value false turns it off.
flags.onDefaultReason: Background sweeper on by default. No compose line sets it, so only the process environment can opt out.

flags.name: CSP_REPORT_LOG_HOSTS
flags.purpose: WS07-S6: logs the blocked origin (scheme and host, never a path or query) of each CSP report, for a host inventory. Dev only: forced off when APP_ENV is production. Only 1, true, yes or on turns it on.

flags.name: CUSTOMER_GATEWAY_CONNECTIONS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Customer-gateway model connections: an org's own OpenAI-compatible endpoint, sealed here. Needs CUSTOMER_GATEWAY_MODEL_PLANE_API_KEY (or the Codex key) and the encryption key. Off, the routes answer 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CUSTOM_REST_CONNECTORS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: A server-side REST proxy for custom_rest connections, using a sealed credential binding's secret. Needs CREDENTIAL_BINDINGS_ENABLED (config refuses otherwise). Off, the provider is unknown. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: DEEP_RESEARCH_CONNECTOR_SOURCES
flags.purpose: EP-2 S7: selected connected accounts as deep research sources. Also needs CONNECTOR_ASK_READS_ENABLED. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: DEEP_RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES
flags.purpose: EP-2 S7: org knowledge per sub-query in deep research, and knowledge_only research. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: DEEP_RESEARCH_PLAN_TURN
flags.purpose: EP-2 S5: deep research shows an editable plan first (research_phase plan or run). Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: DEEP_RESEARCH_SECOND_PASS
flags.purpose: EP-2 S6: the claim ledger and the gap-driven second pass of deep research. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_BLOCKLIST_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Blocks disposable e-mail domains (auth-core security/disposable-email.ts). On unless the value is the literal false, in any case; 0 and off keep it on.
flags.onDefaultReason: Protective control: the disposable-domain blocklist is on unless an operator sets the literal false.

flags.name: DREAMING_LLM_EXTRACTION
flags.purpose: Dreaming LLM extraction, which sends chat transcripts to a model to propose memories. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: ENABLE_COMPAT_ADAPTER
flags.purpose: Subscribes the legacy-message compat handler to the legacy run-event, session-command and aqencia subjects on NATS. Only the exact literal true turns it on; the Model Plane compose writes it out as false.

flags.name: ERASURE_HOLD_CHECK
flags.purpose: EP-9 C4: before an erasure, org-core and session-core ask whether the org or thread is under a legal hold, and a held erasure is refused (session-core audits the refusal content-free). Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGERS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 W4-F T1: the event trigger record store (session-core). Records only; nothing fires until the consumer and FireAuthorizer exist. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGERS_UI_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-T7: the event trigger routes (/api/v1/event-triggers and its dry run). Off, the paths are absent and answer the fallback 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGER_FIRE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 W4-F T2: the event trigger fire path in capability-core (the webhook_received consumer and the fire sweeper). Records and authorises fires only; no run starts until the wake gate lands. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGER_RUN_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 T4 trigger starter: an authorised fire of a trigger naming a cron schedule becomes one scheduled run, re-authorised by Control and bounded by run, hourly and org limits. Needs EVENT_TRIGGER_FIRE_ENABLED. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGER_WAKE_GATE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 W4-F T5: the wake gate in capability-core. A fire of a trigger with a wake filter reads its webhook payload from integration-corev2 and needs a match. Off, stored filters are ignored. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTE_STEP_SPACE_SEARCH_WITHHOLD
flags.purpose: D2-771: ExecuteStep withholds a Space-scoped knowledge_search (typed PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE_UNAVAILABLE, before any Data Plane call) unless x-space-retrieval-authorization is forwarded. Off, org-wide. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_COORDINATOR_MODE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Coordinator Do runs get only read and subagent delegation tools, so effects go through subagents. Never for ZDR, waived or continued runs; the gateway forwards the flag only while on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_BEARER_EXPIRY_GUARD
flags.purpose: F-f05-15: a browser open, act or released call on a bearer expiring within 20 s is refused; a thread-scope code_interpreter on one runs ephemerally, workspace refused. Cleanup and Space runs: not covered. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_BEARER_EXPIRY_PARK
flags.purpose: F-f05-15b: a Do run whose browser or sandbox bearer nears expiry parks (credential_expiring). Needs EXECUTION_CORE_BEARER_EXPIRY_GUARD, EXECUTION_LOOP_PARKING_ENABLED and EXECUTION_LOOP_RESUME_ENABLED. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_BROWSER_FILL_OTP
flags.purpose: QF-16 (E3.1): a leased non-ZDR browser run with one google or microsoft mail connection may propose fill_otp; each use needs a Login approval and a single-use broker fill_otp grant. Literal true only.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_LEASE_RELEASE_FILTER
flags.purpose: W4-P6: lease release never uploads an unfiltered Space workspace: a ZDR or waived run's workspace is discarded before any upload, other runs upload only write-through-eligible files. Off, unchanged. Only the literal true; read at start.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_PLANNER_RUN_ENV
flags.purpose: E4.3: the planner's view of a leased browser run names the browser environment (tier and Quarry's capability booleans), as advisory text. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_PROVIDER_CONTENT_READS
flags.purpose: Q4-E4.3 (056a/c): the agent's provider content reads (github contents.get, readme.get, notion page.content), their decode and larger caps. Off: not offered, gated as unknown, 2000/8000 caps. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_QUARRY_ATTRIBUTION
flags.purpose: Q4 E4.6 (062a): execution-core's web search, fetch and crawl tools send x-request-id and x-verevon-parent-run to Quarry so its traces join the run. Neither is sent for a ZDR or waived step. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_RECIPE_RUNNER
flags.purpose: Q4-E4.2-3h: a browser run whose input names a saved recipe replays that procedure step by step with Quarry, under its own broker grant. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_SCHEDULED_CONTRACT_REQUIRED
flags.purpose: WS20-S5: with the literal true, a step decision must name exactly its run's stored contract, and a run with none refuses one. Off, such a run is not refused for that. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_SKILL_PINS
flags.purpose: EP-11 S3: a Do run records the skill versions it injected, and reattach_skill reads the pinned version. Never for ZDR or waived runs. Off reads the current skill row. Only the literal true; read at start, restart to change.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_SKILL_URL_MATCH
flags.purpose: Q4-E4.3-043c2: a browser run appends the site-skill blocks whose url_patterns match the page after screening. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_SPACE_APPROVAL_GATE
flags.purpose: WS10-S3: the Space approval gate. off keeps today's behaviour, shadow reads Control's tool levels and only counts, enforce folds them in. Unset is off in the code; dev compose defaults to enforce, production and release set off.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CUSTOM_REST_TOOLS
flags.purpose: W4-CC-7 custom REST tools on a turn with a selected connection: Do offers read and write, Ask offers read; writes pause for approval; capabilities start unavailable until attested; ZDR and waived refused. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_DEFERRED_TOOL_INDEX_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W5-070: the Do loop's deferred tool index. Off, a run gets its whole catalogue. On, a catalogue over EXECUTION_DEFERRED_TOOL_INDEX_THRESHOLD offers its MCP and client tools once tool_search reveals them. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_DO_COMPUTER_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-C C1: the Do loop's computer tools (execution-core). Only the literal true turns them on, and even on, every call is refused computer_unavailable until a backend is built.

flags.name: EXECUTION_POST_MUTATION_VERIFY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Reads each write back in the loop and records the result. Read on every write, so a change needs a restart. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_PROCESS_OUTPUT_SPILL
flags.purpose: W4-P6 process_read spill: writes a background process's output beyond one page into a workspace file under .tmp, never uploaded. Only the literal true turns it on. Refused on zero-retention or waived runs. Read once at start.

flags.name: EXECUTION_PROCESS_TTY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: S4.2 process_start tty: a background process on a pseudo-terminal (120x40, TERM=dumb), one output stream. Off gives plain pipes; ZDR and waived tty requests are always refused. Only the literal true; read at start.

flags.name: EXECUTION_PROMPT_SECTION_NAMES
flags.purpose: F-f08-16/F-f08-15: a run seeds its tagged authored sections, profile and memory as named system messages. The gateway needs MODEL_GATEWAY_PROMPT_SECTION_NAMES on to send them. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_SCREEN_INFERENCE_CREDENTIAL
flags.purpose: F-f04-12: a Do run's tool-result screening call may present the screening principal's classifier credential; off, none. Needs CONTENT_SAFETY_SCREEN_RPC and the gateway CONTENT_SAFETY_SEMANTIC_INLINE. Never ZDR. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_SCREEN_ORG_POLICY
flags.purpose: F-f04-13: a failed Do verdict follows the org fail mode; a ZDR or waived run may ask for the rule verdict. Needs CONTENT_SAFETY_SCREEN_RPC; enforce withholding also needs the gateway CONTENT_SAFETY_SEMANTIC_INLINE. Literal true only.

flags.name: EXECUTION_SHADOW_REVIEWER
flags.purpose: W5-097-a shadow reviewer: one tool-free inference judges an effectful Do call; the verdict is only counted and logged, never read by permissions, hooks or approvals. ZDR and waived runs skipped. Only the literal true.

flags.name: FEEDBACK_SKILL_VERSIONS
flags.purpose: EP-11 S3 part b: keys feedback ratings by skill version and quarantines a skill only when its newest rated version is below the bar. Only the literal true turns it on; off pools every rating per skill id as before.

flags.name: FINETUNE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Fine-tuning routes master switch. Only the exact literal true enables it.

flags.name: GATEWAY_AGENT_API_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-12 S8: the public Agent API ingress (/api/agent/v1/*), which exchanges x-api-key at auth-core with the verevon-gateway principal. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: GATEWAY_AGENT_API_IDEMPOTENCY
flags.purpose: F-f08-13: the public Agent API ingress reads and forwards the caller's one Idempotency-Key, only while GATEWAY_AGENT_API_ENABLED is on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: GATEWAY_CHAT_PROJECTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS18-S4: while off, a project start (first send of a chat in a Space, no thread_id) is refused with 404 chat_projects_disabled on every chat path; capabilities omit chat_projects. Flip with VITE_CHAT_PROJECTS_ENABLED. Literal true only.

flags.name: GATEWAY_RATE_CLASSES
flags.purpose: The per-class rate limit layers of the gateway. off, 0, false or no removes them and leaves the default limiter. Unset or any other value keeps them on.
flags.onDefaultReason: Per-class rate limits are on by default. Only off, 0, false or no removes the class layers.

flags.name: GATEWAY_RESULT_CACHE_CONTENT
flags.purpose: Whether the gateway result cache may use its two content caches, search results and scrape previews. Read once at connect. off, 0 or false disables them; the identity and posture caches are not affected.
flags.onDefaultReason: The two content caches are on by default, as they were before this switch was declared.

flags.name: GATEWAY_SPACE_APPEND_RETRIEVAL
flags.purpose: WS18-S2: a follow-up turn of a scoped thread fetches its own retrieval decision and carries its token. Only the literal true turns it on; it never defaults on, even in development.

flags.name: GATEWAY_SPACE_MEMORY_UI
flags.purpose: EP-8 S7: the Space memory routes, which list and delete a room memory. Off, they answer 404 feature_unavailable. Only the literal true turns it on; it never defaults on, even in development.

flags.name: GATEWAY_ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-03c: the BFF's one org-posture reader answers from org-core's effective_zdr instead of parsing the stored intent. Off keeps the intent-only rule. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: GATEWAY_ZDR_LOG_FILTER
flags.purpose: The sensitive-field filter of the gateway JSON log. Only off, 0 or false (any case) disables it; any other value keeps it on.
flags.onDefaultReason: The sensitive-field log filter is part of Zero Data Retention, so it stays on unless an operator sets off, 0 or false.

flags.name: GRAFANA_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Anonymous Viewer access to the Control Plane Grafana, set as GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED on controlplane-grafana. Off keeps Grafana behind its login. The Grafana image reads it, not repo code.

flags.name: HOOKS_DURABLE
flags.purpose: WS25-S8: org hook rules are read from and written to capability-core, not only the in-memory registry. Only the literal true turns it on; off keeps the in-memory registry.

flags.name: INFERENCE_ANTHROPIC_TIERED_SYSTEM
flags.purpose: WS02-S9: the Anthropic system prompt as ordered blocks, one per prompt tier, with Stable and Context marked for caching. Off, one joined string. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: INFERENCE_API_KEY_PRINCIPAL
flags.purpose: EP-12 S6: admits the api_key principal type on inference-core. Off, an api_key token is unauthenticated, as before. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: INFERENCE_BYO_GATEWAY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-t3-065 phase 2: a call naming a customer-gateway connection is served by that gateway alone through Integration Core, never a platform provider; never ZDR, billed to the customer. Off refuses it. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_CATALOGUE_OVERLAY
flags.purpose: F-t3-065 phase 1: the platform catalogue overlay (hide, order, model-id aliases) for the listing and pinned requests; it does not change how a model is served. Off ignores a stored overlay. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_CORE_ANTHROPIC_ADAPTIVE_THINKING
flags.purpose: Anthropic: on renders the canonical effort ladder per model class; off keeps the budget block byte-for-byte. Claude 5.5 takes the ladder whatever this says. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: INFERENCE_CORE_CODEX_WIDE_EFFORT
flags.purpose: Widens the Codex subscription effort ladder to Medium and XHigh; the subscription broker must accept those values first. Only the exact literal true turns it on; 1, on and TRUE leave it off.

flags.name: INFERENCE_CORE_EFFORT_BUDGET_CLAMP
flags.purpose: Clamps effort to Low when the org's budget is exhausted, in the inference-core provider fallback. Only the exact literal true turns it on; 1, on and TRUE leave it off.

flags.name: INFERENCE_CORE_OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT
flags.purpose: Sends reasoning_effort to OpenAI and raises the completion ceiling by the level's allowance. Only the literal true turns it on; a stray 1 or on must not spend the allowance.

flags.name: INFERENCE_GEMINI_EFFORT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-13: sends thinkingConfig on Gemini requests and lists effort levels for Gemini models. Only the literal true turns it on; off, a Gemini request is unchanged.

flags.name: INFERENCE_LOGPROBS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Master switch for the logprobs request parameter on every provider. 0, false, no or off turns it off.
flags.onDefaultReason: On by default. No compose line sets it, so only the process environment can opt out.

flags.name: INFERENCE_OPENAI_PROMPT_CACHE_KEY
flags.purpose: WS02-S10: sends the provider prompt-cache routing key to the first-party OpenAI endpoint only, never on a ZDR request. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: INFERENCE_ORG_OVERLAY
flags.purpose: W4-BYO-3 org overlay (hide, order, role candidates; narrow-only) read from session-core, applied after the platform overlay; entitlement and ZDR, privacy and residency floors apply. Needs SESSION_ORG_ROUTING_OVERLAY. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_PROVIDER_BENCHING
flags.purpose: Benches a failing platform provider and model for a bounded time, never routes a platform request to a user subscription route, and refuses typed when all are benched. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_REQUEST_CAPTURE
flags.purpose: Snapshots an inference call that names a run, for session-core. ZDR, waived and run-less calls are never snapshotted. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: INFERENCE_ROUTE_NOTE
flags.purpose: WS27-S7: the route note, what the budget did to a Verevon call, carried on the wire. Only the literal true turns it on, read once at startup.

flags.name: INFERENCE_SAME_TIER_FALLBACK
flags.purpose: Keeps every fallback hop of a call at or above the privacy tier of the first eligible provider. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_SPEED_TIER_SPLIT
flags.purpose: Speed tier is its own choice, not Quick's. On, a request takes priority with speed_tier only where the model record declares it. Off, Quick selects priority as before. Only the literal true enables it.

flags.name: INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Rate limiter on the integration-corev2 API, sized by INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMIT_MAX per INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW. Only a Go false value (0, f, false) turns it off; off, no and disabled leave it on.
flags.onDefaultReason: A protective control: the API rate-limits every deployment unless a Go false value turns it off.

flags.name: INTEGRATION_TOKEN_LEASE_PER_CONSUMER_AUTH
flags.purpose: F-f08-10: POST /internal/connectors/token takes the consumer from the presented key (INTEGRATION_TOKEN_LEASE_CONSUMER_KEYS), and the shared internal key no longer opens it. Off, unchanged. No keys, 401. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INTEGRATION_ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: D-ZDR-10: integration-corev2 reads the organisation's effective ZDR posture (retention_posture.effective_zdr) from org-core instead of the stored intent. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: ISOLATED_E2E
flags.purpose: Isolated e2e marker for the dev-only gates. Each gate opens only when it and ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV_DEFAULTS are the literal 1: model-gateway (also ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_LEGACY_EVENTS), autocomplete-core, imports-core (also ALLOW_LEGACY_TENANT_KEY).

flags.name: LEARNING_PII_SCREEN_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-f01-23: installs the PII and secret screen (learning.PIIScreen) on each learned skill candidate; a candidate with an e-mail, national id, card, IBAN, phone or secret is dropped, never redacted. Off, a no-op. Only the literal true.

flags.name: LEARNING_REVIEW_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Kill switch for the learning review, which sends session transcripts to LEARNING_REVIEW_MODEL.
flags.driftReason: Code is on when unset (parseLearningReviewSwitch). Compose ships false so a stack can keep every model call on one route. Owner decision: keep one side or the other.

flags.name: LEARNING_RUN_EVENTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Writes the run-completed outbox row that feeds the learning loop. false, 0, off or no skips the insert, so no review runs.
flags.onDefaultReason: On by default so the learning loop is live. No compose line sets it, so only the process environment can opt out.

flags.name: LETTA_TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Turns on Letta tool search. Parsed strictly: any value other than true or false is a configuration error.

flags.name: LETTA_TOOL_SEARCH_MODE
flags.purpose: Letta tool-search retrieval mode. The client rejects any other value.

flags.name: LOOP_GUARD_MODE
flags.purpose: WS25-S1/S2: unset or off builds no guard. shadow logs verdicts only; enforce reminds the model and ends a loop. shadow and enforce read in any case; any other value, OFF included, reads as shadow. Enforce only after shadow data (D2-824).

flags.name: LOOP_GUARD_RESULT_AWARE
flags.purpose: WS25-S2 (F-f05-08): with LOOP_GUARD_MODE on, a call whose result changed since its last run is progress, not a repeat or cycle, so polling is not stopped. Off keeps today's rules. Only the literal true turns it on; enable with enforce.

flags.name: MCP_APPS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-4 S8: MCP App resources, read through and never stored. Off by default: only the literal true turns the route on.

flags.name: MCP_APPS_NETWORK_ENABLED
flags.purpose: MCP App frame policy: the resource response carries the frame's csp and the network_origins it grants (the org's mcp_apps.network_origins and the app's own declaration). Only the literal true turns it on; off keeps the no-network response.

flags.name: MCP_APP_TOOL_CALLS
flags.purpose: MCP App tool calls, behind the route switch. Off by default: only the literal true turns the route on.

flags.name: MCP_DNS_REVALIDATOR_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Background DNS revalidator for MCP servers in capability-core. Only the exact value false turns it off.
flags.onDefaultReason: Background revalidator on by default. No compose line sets it, so only the process environment can opt out.

flags.name: MCP_DO_ELICITATION
flags.purpose: EP-4 S7: a Do run's MCP call may carry a server's form to the run's owner as a resume question. Needs the gateway's MCP_ELICITATION_ENABLED and AGENT_ASK_USER_RESUME_ENABLED; run one gateway replica (DEC-F08-06). Only the literal true.

flags.name: MCP_DO_TOOLS
flags.purpose: WS05-S4: MCP tools in a Do run, with TOOL_CLASS_GATE enforce. off offers none, read offers approved read-class tools, all stays blocked until a resumed run can run one. Only the exact words read and all turn them on.

flags.name: MCP_ELICITATION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-4 S4: MCP elicitation, a server's form held in the gateway while the owner answers. Off by default: only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MCP_SECRET_REF_AUTH_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-CC-5: a static-bearer MCP server redeems its integration-corev2 credential binding for each call. Only the literal true turns it on; off, such a registration is refused. A ZDR or waived turn never redeems one.

flags.name: MCP_TOOL_OBSERVATION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS05-S2: posts each MCP tool definition's digest and annotations to capability-core, so a changed tool drifts. Needs MCP_OAUTH_SERVICE_TOKEN. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MEMORY_GATE_CAPABILITY_WRITES
flags.purpose: D2-480: capability-core user, org and global memory saves ask session-core CheckMemoryWrite before INSERT (updates on content change). Refused 403, unreachable 503; delete never gated. Policy per CONTENT_WRITE_POLICY. Only the literal true.

flags.name: MEMORY_GATE_ORCHESTRATOR_WRITES
flags.purpose: D2-481: consolidated memory entries ask session-core CheckMemoryWrite before letta-bridge IndexMemory; refused entries skipped and counted, unreachable writes nothing, ZDR or unattested refused first. Only the literal true.

flags.name: MEMORY_GROUNDING_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Memory grounding pass that lets Dreaming classify candidates. Off by default because it flips is_latest on existing rows. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_ACTION_ADMISSION
flags.purpose: WS24-S6/S8: the agent action admission table. Only the literal table admits named actions and the owner listing, never on retention-bound runs. Unset is off: tickets.create only. With Spaces, enable OWNER_LIST_SPACE_REFUSE first.

flags.name: MODEL_ENTITLEMENT_ADMIN_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS10-S5: the model entitlement admin routes (policy read, write and explain). Do not enable before the matcher and model-gateway admission are deployed. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_AGENT_API
flags.purpose: EP-12 S5: the Agent API read and control routes under /v1/agent/* for API keys with agent:runs. Off by default: only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_AGENT_API_IDEMPOTENCY
flags.purpose: F-f08-13: POST /v1/agent/runs honours the caller's Idempotency-Key (hashed, never stored): the same key on the same body answers the run the first start began and starts nothing. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_AGENT_TOOL_ALLOWLIST
flags.purpose: EP-6 S9: a mention turn's agent tool allowlist and autonomy cap narrow the offered tools. Opt-in: only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_AGENT_USAGE_ENVELOPE
flags.purpose: WS02-S3: the agentic run's ledger row. Off by default, since enabling it starts billing Do runs. Only the literal true enables it.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_AI_CHAT_METERING
flags.purpose: Which POST /v1/ai/chat calls publish a usage envelope to cost-core: nobody (off), service principals, or every caller. Any other value is off, and a ZDR call is never metered.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_AI_LAYOUT_SERVICE
flags.purpose: Service lane of POST /v1/ai/documents/layout (OCR and layout): off, service principals get 404 on it, and users are unaffected. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_AI_PII_SERVICE
flags.purpose: Service lane of POST /v1/ai/language/pii, the optional model tier of the document PII stage: off, service principals get 404 on it, and users are unaffected. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_ARTIFACT_EDITING
flags.purpose: EP-3 S4: the person's own edit and restore of a thread artifact. Refused at boot unless MODEL_GATEWAY_ARTIFACT_REVISIONS is on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_ARTIFACT_REVISIONS
flags.purpose: EP-3 S2: the artifact revision writer. Unset, empty or off writes nothing; shadow appends each revision after the turn is saved and changes nothing the user sees; on writes under the commit lock. Any other value refuses boot.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_ASK_READ_TAINT_HOLD
flags.purpose: F-f04-16: after a flagged or degraded connector read in Ask, web and network tools are withdrawn for the rest of the turn. CONNECTOR_SUGGESTIONS_ENABLED must not go on until this is on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_ASK_USER_ASK_MODE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS14-S6: offer ask_user to an Ask-mode turn in the chat tool loop. Off by default: only the literal true turns it on. ZDR, waived and Space-scoped turns never get it.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_ASSISTANT_NAVIGATION
flags.purpose: Assistant navigation durable runs at POST /v1/ai/assistant-navigation. Off by default: only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_AUTH_DEV_BYPASS
flags.purpose: Local-dev auth bypass that accepts an unverified bearer. Only the exact literal true turns it on, and only with ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV_DEFAULTS=1, also read exactly; otherwise startup is refused.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_ATTACH
flags.purpose: WS8.G browser attach: a run start with attach_session_id is refused 400 browser_attach_unavailable while off. Also needs BROWSER_BROKER_HUMAN_BROWSE_ENABLED and QUARRY_EDGE__ATTACH. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_ATTACH_POLICY_ENFORCED
flags.purpose: Attach-policy enforcement: a browser run start that carries both an attach session and a policy ask is refused 412 browser_attach_policy_unavailable while off. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_BUDGET_CLAIM
flags.purpose: Mints a budget claim on a browser run grant from the organization's per-run ceiling, so the broker stores the bound. Only the exact literal true turns it on; a misspelt value is off.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_KEY_GRANTS
flags.purpose: Key-grant routes for an api_key principal (POST and DELETE under /v1/browser/key-grants): off answers 404. The broker's BROWSER_BROKER_KEY_GRANTS_ENABLED still applies. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_PAGE_CONTEXT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: QF-10: chat turns read BFF-verified browser_tab_refs and browser_regions as untrusted browser-scraped context and region image parts. Literal true only; ZDR or waived turns are refused.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_PLANNER_QUOTAS
flags.purpose: A browser run start reads the org's planner quota rows (token ceiling and LLM-planner switch) from org-core. Off, nothing is read and the ceiling is the request's own. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_POLICY_ASK
flags.purpose: A browser run start may carry a policy ask or plan mode, forwarded to Quarry. Off, such a start is refused 400 browser_policy_ask_unavailable rather than run unrestricted. Only the exact literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_RECIPE
flags.purpose: Q4-E4.2-3i: a browser run start may name a saved recipe (tool_input.recipe, for_user_id from the verified claims). Off refuses it 400 browser_recipe_unavailable. Literal true only; needs EXECUTION_CORE_RECIPE_RUNNER.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BUDGET_WINDOW
flags.purpose: WS27-S8: the windowed org budget, read per request. Off, the check counts lifetime spend as before. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BUDGET_WINDOW_PER_CAP
flags.purpose: F-f02-04: the cost cap and the token cap are each measured over their own reset window, not the widest. Needs MODEL_GATEWAY_BUDGET_WINDOW on; deploy cost-core first. Off keeps the shared window. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BYO_GATEWAY
flags.purpose: W4-BYO-6 customer gateway on a chat turn: accepts an opaque customer-gateway connection id, text-only and never zero retention. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_CACHE_ANTHROPIC_STABLE_ORDER
flags.purpose: Carries the stable prompt order to Claude API routes, where inference-core caches the standing blocks once the tier plan names them. Needs MODEL_GATEWAY_CACHE_STABLE_PROMPT_ORDER on. Only the literal true.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_CACHE_STABLE_PROMPT_ORDER
flags.purpose: Stable prompt ordering for cache hits on OpenAI-API chat routes. Only the literal true turns it on; blank means off.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_CAP_MIN

flags.purpose: Web-policy claim on tokens for the audiences that carry it (auth-core web-policy.ts). Off, such a token carries rev 0 and org-core is never asked. Only 1 or true turns it on.

flags.name: ZDR_WAIVER_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-14: the per-connection ZDR waiver issuer. Off refuses every waiver with zdr_connection_not_supported. Only the literal true turns it on.
